structured_output.what_is_happening: 白头鹰 ("bald eagle" in Chinese) is a Chinese-named Solana meme launched about 40 minutes before detection, at 03:23 UTC on 2026-09-25. It refers to a real news event from a few hours earlier: at the White House state dinner on 2026-09-24, Trump gave Xi Jinping a three-foot bald eagle statue. Major outlets covered it (Washington Examiner, Benzinga, Yahoo, Tribune). The token is up about 637% in an hour, with about $680k of volume at a $138k market cap. It is the largest of five same-name tokens launched in the last two hours; the nearest rival is at $57k. Detection happened at about noon Beijing time, so Chinese crypto traders are active. The pool is a PumpSwap pool created seconds after the token was minted, with no pump.fun bonding-curve migration recorded, and RugCheck flags its LP as 0% locked with few LP providers. That means whoever seeded the roughly $104k of liquidity can likely pull it.
